            '  Future<ImOutboxResultVerdict> _recordOutboxSdkResult({\n'
            '    required String ownerUserId,\n'
            '    required String operationId,\n'
            '    required String leaseOwnerId,\n'
            '    required int fencingToken,\n'
            '    required int nowMs,\n'
            '    required ImOutboxState nextMainState,\n'
            '    String? sdkLocalId,\n'
            '    String? serverMsgId,\n'
            '    String? resultCode,\n'
            '    String? expectedAttemptId,\n'
            '    bool providerEvidence = false,\n'
            '    String? expectedCorrelationId,\n'
            '    String? expectedConversationId,\n'
            '    String? expectedPayloadHash,\n'
            '  }) async {\n'
            '    if (nextMainState != ImOutboxState.acknowledged &&\n'
            '        nextMainState != ImOutboxState.failedTerminal) {\n'
            '      throw ArgumentError.value(nextMainState, \'nextMainState\');\n'
            '    }\n'
            '    final result =\n'
            '        await _store.transaction<ImOutboxResultVerdict>((transaction) async {\n'
            '      if (!await _hasCurrentLease(\n'
            '          transaction, ownerUserId, leaseOwnerId, fencingToken, nowMs)) {\n'
            '        return const ImOutboxResultVerdict(\n'
            '            decision: ImOutboxResultDecision.fencingRejected,\n'
            '            reason: \'writer_lease_rejected\');\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      final main = await transaction.findOutbox(\n'
            '          ownerUserId: ownerUserId, operationId: operationId);\n'
            '      final copy = await transaction.findOutboxRecovery(\n'
            '          ownerUserId: ownerUserId, operationId: operationId);\n'
            '      ImOutboxResultVerdict verdict(\n'
            '              ImOutboxResultDecision decision, String reason) =>\n'
            '          ImOutboxResultVerdict(\n'
            '              decision: decision,\n'
            '              main: main,\n'
            '              recoveryCopy: copy,\n'
            '              eventAttemptId: expectedAttemptId,\n'
            '              reason: reason);\n'
            '      if (main == null || copy == null)\n'
            '        return verdict(ImOutboxResultDecision.missing, \'outbox_missing\');\n'
            '      if (!_sameOutboxIdentity(main, copy) ||\n'
            '          (main.dispatchAttemptId != null &&\n'
            '              copy.dispatchAttemptId != null &&\n'
            '              main.dispatchAttemptId != copy.dispatchAttemptId) ||\n'
            '          (providerEvidence &&\n'
            '              (main.clientCorrelationId != expectedCorrelationId ||\n'
            '                  main.conversationId != expectedConversationId ||\n'
            '                  main.payloadHash != expectedPayloadHash))) {\n'
            '        return verdict(ImOutboxResultDecision.identityConflict,\n'
            '            \'outbox_identity_conflict\');\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (!providerEvidence &&\n'
            '          expectedAttemptId != null &&\n'
            '          main.dispatchAttemptId != expectedAttemptId) {\n'
            '        return verdict(\n'
            '            ImOutboxResultDecision.staleAttempt, \'stale_dispatch_attempt\');\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (main.state == ImOutboxState.acknowledged ||\n'
            '          main.state == ImOutboxState.completed) {\n'
            '        return verdict(\n'
            '            nextMainState == ImOutboxState.acknowledged\n'
            '                ? ImOutboxResultDecision.duplicate\n'
            '                : ImOutboxResultDecision.superseded,\n'
            '            \'delivery_already_confirmed\');\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (main.state == nextMainState &&\n'
            '          (copy.state == ImOutboxCopyState.resultRecorded ||\n'
            '              copy.state == ImOutboxCopyState.reconciled)) {\n'
            '        return verdict(\n'
            '            ImOutboxResultDecision.duplicate, \'result_already_recorded\');\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      // A late dispatch callback is never a recovery query. Exact provider\n'
            '      // evidence may settle an older attempt of the SAME business operation.\n'
            '      final providerCanSettle = providerEvidence &&\n'
            '          <ImOutboxState>{\n'
            '            ImOutboxState.sending,\n'
            '            ImOutboxState.dispatchIntent,\n'
            '            ImOutboxState.outcomeUnknown,\n'
            '            ImOutboxState.failedTerminal,\n'
            '            ImOutboxState.abandonedByUser,\n'
            '          }.contains(main.state);\n'
            '      if (!providerCanSettle && main.state != ImOutboxState.sending) {\n'
            '        return verdict(ImOutboxResultDecision.deferred,\n'
            '            \'state_requires_recovery_evidence\');\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      if (!<ImOutboxCopyState>{\n'
            '        ImOutboxCopyState.dispatchIntent,\n'
            '        ImOutboxCopyState.outcomeUnknown,\n'
            '        ImOutboxCopyState.resultRecorded,\n'
            '        ImOutboxCopyState.reconciled\n'
            '      }.contains(copy.state)) {\n'
            '        return verdict(\n'
            '            ImOutboxResultDecision.identityConflict, \'recovery_state_conflict\');\n'
            '      }\n'
            '      final resultCopy = ImOutboxRecoveryRecord(\n'
            '        ownerUserId: copy.ownerUserId,\n'
            '        operationId: copy.operationId,\n'
            '        clientCorrelationId: copy.clientCorrelationId,\n'
            '        conversationId: copy.conversationId,\n'
            '        messageType: copy.messageType,\n'
            '        recoveryRevision: copy.recoveryRevision + 1,\n'
            '        state: copy.state == ImOutboxCopyState.dispatchIntent\n'
            '            ? ImOutboxCopyState.resultRecorded\n'
            '            : ImOutboxCopyState.reconciled,\n'
            '        dispatchAttemptId: copy.dispatchAttemptId,\n'
            '        dispatchIntentAtMs: copy.dispatchIntentAtMs,\n'
            '        payloadReferenceOrCiphertext: copy.payloadReferenceOrCiphertext,\n'
            '        payloadHash: copy.payloadHash,\n'
            '        checksum: copy.checksum,\n'
            '        sdkLocalId: copy.sdkLocalId ?? sdkLocalId,\n'
            '        serverMsgId: serverMsgId ?? copy.serverMsgId,\n'
            '        resultCode: resultCode ?? copy.resultCode,\n'
            '        updatedAtMs: nowMs,\n'
            '      );\n'
            '      final changedCopy = await transaction.updateOutboxRecoveryIfCurrent(\n'
            '          record: resultCopy,\n'
            '          expectedState: copy.state,\n'
            '          leaseOwnerId: leaseOwnerId,\n'
            '          fencingToken: fencingToken,\n'
            '          nowMs: nowMs);\n'
            '      if (!changedCopy) throw StateError(\'Outbox result copy CAS rejected\');\n'
            '      final resultMain = main.copyWith(\n'
            '          state: nextMainState,\n'
            '          sdkMessageId: main.sdkMessageId ?? sdkLocalId,\n'
            '          serverMsgId: serverMsgId,\n'
            '          resultCode: resultCode,\n'
            '          updatedAtMs: nowMs,\n'
            '          leaseOwnerId: leaseOwnerId,\n'
            '          fencingToken: fencingToken);\n'
            '      final changedMain = await transaction.updateOutboxIfCurrent(\n'
            '          record: resultMain,\n'
            '          expectedState: main.state,\n'
            '          leaseOwnerId: leaseOwnerId,\n'
            '          fencingToken: fencingToken,\n'
            '          nowMs: nowMs);\n'
            '      // Throw, rather than committing only one side of the transaction.\n'
            '      if (!changedMain) throw StateError(\'Outbox result main CAS rejected\');\n'
            '      return ImOutboxResultVerdict(\n'
            '          decision: ImOutboxResultDecision.accepted,\n'
            '          main: resultMain,\n'
            '          recoveryCopy: resultCopy,\n'
            '          eventAttemptId: expectedAttemptId,\n'
            '          reason: providerEvidence ? \'provider_observed\' : \'sdk_result\');\n'
            '    });\n'
            '    return _publishResult(result);\n'
            '  }\n'

            '\n'

            '\n'
            'class Im05IdentityConflictException implements Exception {\n'
            '  const Im05IdentityConflictException(this.message);\n'
            '\n'
            '  final String message;\n'
            '\n'
            '  @override\n'
            '  String toString() => \'IM-05 identity conflict: $message\';\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'Future<bool> _hasCurrentLease(\n'
            '  Im05Transaction transaction,\n'
            '  String ownerUserId,\n'
            '  String leaseOwnerId,\n'
            '  int fencingToken,\n'
            '  int nowMs,\n'
            ') async {\n'
            '  final lease = await transaction.findWriterLease(ownerUserId);\n'
            '  return lease != null &&\n'
            '      lease.leaseOwnerId == leaseOwnerId &&\n'
            '      lease.fencingToken == fencingToken &&\n'
            '      !lease.isExpiredAt(nowMs);\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'void _checkJournalIdentity(\n'
            '  ImCommitJournalRecord current,\n'
            '  ImCommitJournalRecord expected,\n'
            ') {\n'
            '  if (current.eventNamespace != expected.eventNamespace ||\n'
            '      current.eventId != expected.eventId ||\n'
            '      current.scope != expected.scope ||\n'
            '      current.commitRevision != expected.commitRevision) {\n'
            '    throw const Im05IdentityConflictException(\'journal identity conflict\');\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'void _checkCheckpointIdentity(\n'
            '  ImProjectionCheckpointRecord checkpoint,\n'
            '  ImCommitJournalRecord journal,\n'
            ') {\n'
            '  if (checkpoint.ownerUserId != journal.ownerUserId ||\n'
            '      checkpoint.scope != journal.scope ||\n'
            '      checkpoint.commitRevision != journal.commitRevision ||\n'
            '      checkpoint.lastJournalId != journal.journalId) {\n'
            '    throw const Im05IdentityConflictException(\'checkpoint does not match\');\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'void _checkOutboxRecordIdentity(\n'
            '  ImOutboxRecord current,\n'
            '  ImOutboxRecord expected,\n'
            ') {\n'
            '  if (current.ownerUserId != expected.ownerUserId ||\n'
            '      current.operationId != expected.operationId ||\n'
            '      current.conversationId != expected.conversationId ||\n'
            '      current.clientCorrelationId != expected.clientCorrelationId ||\n'
            '      current.messageType != expected.messageType ||\n'
            '      current.payloadReference != expected.payloadReference ||\n'
            '      current.payloadHash != expected.payloadHash) {\n'
            '    throw const Im05IdentityConflictException(\'outbox identity conflict\');\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'void _checkRecoveryIdentity(\n'
            '  ImOutboxRecoveryRecord current,\n'
            '  ImOutboxRecoveryRecord expected,\n'
            ') {\n'
            '  if (!_sameRecoveryIdentity(current, expected)) {\n'
            '    throw const Im05IdentityConflictException(\n'
            '      \'outbox recovery identity conflict\',\n'
            '    );\n'
            '  }\n'
            '}\n'
            '\n'
            'bool _sameOutboxIdentity(\n'
            '  ImOutboxRecord main,\n'
            '  ImOutboxRecoveryRecord copy,\n'
            ') {\n'
            '  return main.ownerUserId == copy.ownerUserId &&\n'
